title: Tug of Watts: A study on the Energy - Accuracy Trade-off of Large Language Models on Medical Question Answering Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.02889v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in medical question answering (QA) systems. While recent works aim at incrementally improving the downstream task accuracy, an empirical estimation of the models' energy consumption and the associated carbon footprints is often overlooked. In this study, we demonstrate how practitioners can estimate energy consumption and arrive at reliable emission estimates for medical QA tasks available in the OpenMedical-LLM leaderboard by investigating 13 LLMs from 3 model families ranging from 270M to 14B parameters. We discuss how one can critically interpret energy versus accuracy trade-offs for a set of models for a given task. With this work, we underline that reporting disjoint energy and accuracy metrics alone does not suffice for careful trade-off assessments, but it also demands systematic construction and interpretation of joint trade-off metrics. translated_title: 瓦特拔河：大型语言模型在医疗问答任务中的能耗与准确率权衡研究
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在医疗问答（QA）系统中的应用日益广泛。尽管近期的研究工作旨在逐步提升下游任务的准确率，但对模型能耗及相应碳足迹的实证估算往往被忽视。在本研究中，我们通过考察来自3个模型家族、参数规模从2.7亿（270M）到140亿（14B）的13个大型语言模型，展示了从业者如何能够为OpenMedical-LLM排行榜上可用的医疗问答任务估算能耗并获得可靠的碳排放评估。我们讨论了如何批判性地解读一组模型在给定任务上的能耗与准确率之间的权衡。通过这项工作，我们强调仅报告相互独立的能耗和准确率指标不足以进行细致的权衡评估，还需要系统地构建和解读联合权衡指标。我们预想此类研究将帮助从业者……
tldr: 本研究通过对13个不同规模的大型语言模型在医疗问答任务上的能耗与准确率分析，提出了系统构建和解读能耗-准确率联合权衡指标的方法，强调仅分别报告这两项指标不足以支撑严谨的权衡评估。
en_tdlr: By evaluating 13 LLMs of varying sizes on medical QA tasks, this study demonstrates how practitioners can reliably estimate energy consumption and carbon emissions, and argues that careful trade-off assessment requires systematically constructing joint energy-accuracy metrics rather than reporting them in isolation.
